title: Geek Bar Pulse Pink Lemonade Vape 15000 Puffs
description:
Geek Bar Pulse Pink Lemonade Vape with Amazing 15000 Puffs
The flawless blend of zesty lemons and juicy strawberries makes the Pink Lemonade Geek Bar Pulse 15000 stand out. The standard mode, which has two power settings, uses a mesh coil to provide constant taste and longer battery life, guaranteeing up to 15,000 puffs. For an additional boost, turn on pulse mode, which increases output and airflow to 20W and produces thick vapor and a fully flavorful experience for up to 7,500 puffs.
Get Superior Performance
With a 5% nicotine concentration, this disposable vaporizer delivers a hit that’s enjoyable every time. The 16 ml preloaded e-liquid reservoir guarantees a longer vaping session before needing to be replaced. With the USB Type-C connection, the 650mAh built-in battery allows for quick recharging after extended usage. Vapers may enjoy a zesty and sweet getaway with the Pink Lemonade Geek Bar Pulse 15000, which combines great performance with an easy-to-use draw-activated mechanism and integrated twin mesh coil.
A REVIEW OF PINK LEMONADE FLAVOR
Savor the delicious combination of sweet strawberries and tart lemons that makes for the ideal geek bar pulse pink lemonade taste. Every puff recreates the traditional summertime beverage with a zesty citrus inhale and a sweet, lingering exhale.
Know Additional Features
Up to 15000 puffs
Boost Mode For Enhanced Airflow, Vapour And Flavour
LED Screen with E-Liquid and Battery indicators
Rechargeable
Dual Mesh Coil
16 mL of E-Liquid
20mg/mL
650 mAh Internal Battery
FAQ
What are the key features of the Pink Lemonade Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
Key features include dual mesh coil, LED screen, 16mL e-liquid capacity, and up to 15000 puffs.
How does the pulse mode work on the Geek Bar Pulse Pink Lemonade?
Pulse mode increases output and airflow to 20W, providing thicker vapor and enhanced flavor.
Is the Geek Bar Pulse Pink Lemonade suitable for travel?
Yes, its compact design and long-lasting battery make it ideal for on-the-go vaping.
Where can I buy the Geek Bar Pulse Pink Lemonade?
You can purchase it from authorized retailers and online vape stores that carry Geek Bar products.
